_about: Package VS (twin-dial round 1): the proposed app.json "signals" block for twin_dial. READ ONLY: no "w" flag, no setter, no KombiIF.standardCCMessage / extendedCCMessage / operationBordcomputer / kombiSelection / timeDate. Every "r" has a NON-ZERO getter id in the car's catalogue (reference/car/2026-11-15/someip/someip-interfaces.json); fields with no getter are "s" only. Checked with tools/signals/check_signals.py on a scratch app.json (bake/work/twin-dial/vs/app.json). Keys starting with '_' are notes and are ignored by the generator. Groups: 'carried' = what f30_cluster already reads on this car; 'new' = new content, NOT yet seen on this car (probe list in docs/twin-dial/VS-REPORT.md).

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.CDS._carried: rpm (x0.25), coolant / oil (raw - 48 C, 255 = none), engine running
de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.CDS._new: statusBattery2.conditionBatteryChargingCondition (getter 5): a charge-condition byte, NOT a voltage; scaling unknown, probe first

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle2._new: statusDisplayedCCMessage (getter 61): the number of the message the cluster displays - a second witness beside KombiIF.statusActiveCCMessage; statusZVStatus (getter 85): central locking and boot lid unlocked, for the car picture

de.bmw.infrastructure.VehicleInformation._new: Range.mileageKilometre: the odometer, notifier only (32770); the first-choice odometer is KombiIF.statusRangeTankStatus.mileageKilometre (has a getter)

de.bmw.infrastructure.EnvironmentalInfor._new: UnitBN2020.unitOfMeasurementMileage (getter 1): km or miles for the odometer and trip

de.bmw.infotainment.KombiIF._carried: statusRangeTankStatus (fuel litres 255 = none, range km 4095 = none), timeDateUTC, statusShowTimeDate, statusActiveCCMessage, statusMenuCCMessage
de.bmw.infotainment.KombiIF._new: the trip computer (Bordcomputer*), statusRangeTankStatus.mileageKilometre (odometer), dataInstrumentPack.engineTemperatureEvaluated (BMW's own COLD/OK/HOT/dashes verdict for the coolant bar), statusKombiExternalDisplay (the cluster's outside temperature, range and C/F), the cluster-view candidates statusKombiSelection / statusKombiSelectionAvailability / statusConfigurationKombi5

de.bmw.infotainment.KombiInterface_2._carried: ccList: the messages' names, colours and symbol ids (live on this car); ccListRiskClass: the 0.7.18 probe. newCCMessage is deliberately NOT declared: it never arrived on this car in 25 min. requestDefaultSymbols is NOT declared: decision 6, we draw our own symbols

de.bmw.infotainment.checkcontrol.CheckCo._new: activeState AKTIV / INAKTIV and reason CCM_SHOWN_BY_IC per ccmId: the candidate for the stored-message marker; log-only until confirmed

de.bmw.body.DoorsWindowsRoofMirrors._new: four door switches, boot lid, bonnet, second flap: the car picture (reference 04). NOTIFIER ONLY (no getter): nothing arrives until a door changes, so the picture starts 'unknown', never 'closed'

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.A4A._new: bonnet only, but with a getter (3): the one lid readable at start

de.bmw.infotainment.hmi.hmimediastate.Hm._new: the two lines the head unit shows for the front player (first/second line text and type ARTIST / ALBUM / TITLE). Text is PERSONAL: never logged, lengths only

de.bmw.infotainment.entertainment.medias._new: the active source id (UTF-16) and the list with displayText and playerType (TUNER_FM ... MEDIA_PLAYER)

de.bmw.infotainment.connectivity.telepho._new: one enum for all phones: DISCONNECTED / INCOMING / ACTIVE / DIALING / HELD. No number or name is read

de.bmw.infotainment.hmi.hmicontext.HMICo._new: the HMI's 'IC widget' (UInt32) and its graphical context: the candidate for following the driver's cluster view. Raw values logged only, meaning unknown

de.bmw.infotainment.navigation.guiding.G._new: nextIntersection (getter 9): the next manoeuvre's road description and formatted distance, for centre proposal (f); the turn arrow itself is a TurnDirection enum inside a large union - parse cost to be checked

_notDeclared.setters_never: KombiIF standardCCMessage (setter 34), extendedCCMessage (33), operationBordcomputer (35), kombiSelection (44), operationConfigKombi (51), timeDate (37), operationTimeDateUTC (52), terminCBS (38): all write into the cluster
_notDeclared.zero_getter: body.AntiTheft.statusDwa: getter id 0 (an 'r' would fail the install); not needed
_notDeclared.voltage: no field on this car carries the 12 V battery VOLTAGE with a getter. Candidates: analytics.BasicDataSet.basicDataSet.statusVoltageIntelligentBoardnetSensor (UInt16, notifier 32769 only, a ~40-member analytics struct, scaling unknown) and Harman LevelMonitor.systemVoltage (instance Inst1 = 128, getter 1; the head unit's own supply, Int16, probably mV). Both are probe-first; neither is declared
_notDeclared.media_alternatives: MediaPlayer.currentItemMetadata has ~50 instances (one per source) and no stable 'current' one; TunerFmAmDabMetadata.currentStationFmDabAm carries picture buffers. Neither is declared
_notDeclared.icview_alternatives: HMIContext2.currentICWidget (VisualContext2 StateID / AppletID, instance '1') and Vehicle2.statusDisplayKombi (STANDARD / M view) - add to the probe if HMIContext gives nothing
